Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, why did you decide to go out with Rinko？
It just popped into my head. What do you like about Rinko？ ...I wondered.
Let's see... You're cheeky, you're not honest with yourself, you're stubborn...
...Hey. I'm asking what you LIKE about me？
Silly. That's what's cute about ▲小早川＊▲. It's endearing.
Harsh. A boyfriend gets hurt when you badmouth his girlfriend, you know？
I asked you this before, but...
About why you decided to go out with Rinko...
Don't you have a simpler reason？ Come on！ Like "you're cute～" or "you're pretty～"？
Oh！ Your eyes are cute, right？
Yeah. Your eyelashes are long and curl up naturally.
Huh, when did you get to study me that closely？
Um, let's see... when we kiss？
Idiot！ You're supposed to close your eyes then！
What does it mean to fall for someone？
Well... I was just thinking it's hard to explain.
Let's see... Isn't it about treasuring the other person, that kind of thing？
That's not what Rinko means... It's more...
Why it has to be that one person.
When you put it that way...
Nobody else will do, right？ What kind of mental wiring causes that？
Hey, is falling for someone just human instinct after all？
Continuing from before？ What do you mean？
Like, DNA humans pass down to keep the species going？
That's one answer, but for ▲小早川＊▲ and me...
What, you mean it was decided from the start？ No way. Rinko chose you herself.
...More importantly, what's your answer to my question？
I got to hear how ▲小早川＊▲ feels, so I'm satisfied. Forget the complicated stuff.
...I'll let it go at that... but I'm not convinced...
If you don't know, that's better for me anyway...
Now, now. You'll find out soon！
Hmm, I want knowledge, I want to be athletic, and I'd like some style and charm too.
Not that kind of thing. Like CDs, books... THINGS.
Hmm... Like what？ Nothing comes to mind...
That's a problem. Think about it properly.
Let's see... a kiss from ▲小早川＊▲？
I'll ask again, so think it over properly by then.
So, did you think about what you want？
Geez, want a kick!? There must be at least one thing you want...
Well, I've got ▲小早川＊▲ as my girlfriend now.
So I feel kind of satisfied...
Hehe... Well. I kind of get how you feel？
Then what would make you happy to get from your girlfriend？
Anything from my girlfriend would make me happy, wouldn't it？
Your birthday's coming up soon, isn't it？
At least remember your own birthday.
Got plans for your birthday？ Like family around a cake going "Happy birthday"？
Nope. I'm too old for birthday parties.
I see. But isn't it nice to have your birthday celebrated？
Sure, it'd be nice. Especially from my girlfriend.
Hmm. Then I'll think about it. Hehe.
Yeah... August's almost here. I seriously hate it.
You don't like the heat, right？
Sigh... it's almost here. It'll be August...
Speaking of August, that's ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday.
Oh, is it？ I wasn't interested, so I forgot. I see, I see～
(▲小早川＊▲'s birthday... What should I do？)
Soon Rinko's going to be a year older too, huh.
One more step up the stairs to adulthood.
But isn't it a little sad, me getting a year older？
Oh, right... You're a lolicon, aren't you？
You'd prefer a grown-up, beautiful woman, right？
To me, ▲小早川＊▲ just as she is is the best.
Maybe for girls it's a more special day than I think？
Until now, when my family celebrated, Rinko was just like, "Huh."
But this year's a special birthday！ Woo-hoo！
It's a birthday I get to spend with my boyfriend.
If you're that excited, it's a little bit of pressure...
Exactly？ I'm putting on a little pressure so you don't bail at the last minute.
Hey... this might be the first time Rinko's ever looked forward to her birthday.
Then I'd better work hard to make ▲小早川＊▲ happy.
Oh right. If there's anything you want, I'll take requests？
Just having the person I love say "happy birthday" is enough.
Yeah？ But thinking up a present for someone you love is fun, you know.
For Rinko, a birthday where she's not alone is the best present.
Do you know what day is coming up？
No... um... so, what day was it？
I'm just exasperated you forgot a day that matters to both of us.
Oh... The day ▲小早川＊▲ and I started going out...
A lot happened this year, huh.
Yeah... I wonder how many of ▲小早川＊▲'s kicks I took this year...？
...Jokes aside. Having ▲小早川＊▲ by my side feels totally natural now...
I get that too. But Rinko still gets butterflies when we're together, you know？
Me too. I still get nervous when we kiss and stuff...
Want more butterflies？ Should we kiss right here？
Don't push your luck！ Want number 101？
Looking back, a year goes by fast...
How do you feel about Rinko now？ Has it changed？ Maybe you've cooled off a little...
Not one bit. I've loved ▲小早川＊▲ the whole time.
What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Have you changed？
Rinko loves you way, waaay more than when we started. So Rinko wins.
Hey, thanks for staying with Rinko for a whole year.
I mean, putting up with someone like me for a whole year.
I haven't been putting up with anything？
Sure, you're like that sometimes, but I've never once hated it.
Next year, I want to talk like this again, about how another year passed...
Not just next year. The year after, and forever...
Why did you go out with Rinko？
Because Rinko's not girly at all, right？
Maybe I kind of forced you to say yes back then...
Of course. I'm glad it's ▲小早川＊▲.
Rinko's glad she got a good boyfriend too, so remember that.
Straight up, what do you like about Rinko？
I figured you'd like someone more mature. Rinko's kind of childish, right？
Or is it because you're a lolicon？
That you're not honest, you're childish, you're selfish...
What's that？ Said like that, Rinko sounds like a total brat!?
Not at all. You're my beloved girlfriend.
Why do you say stuff like that out of nowhere...
See, that's the cute part. Did you notice？
When does liking someone start, I wonder？
Hmm... I've never thought about it.
At first, they're just one of countless passersby.
And before you know it, they're the one person nobody else can replace...
Yeah... But we fell for each other, didn't we...
When you fall for someone, you get more worries, huh.
What's up, all of a sudden？
Isn't that kind of a pain？
There are lots of good things too, like being happy together, right？
But you get selfish, anxious, jealous. Doesn't the other person find that annoying？
Rinko would hate being like that...
But I wonder why... if you got selfish, or jealous over me...
Oh, isn't it coming up soon？
Figures... They say you get forgetful when you get older.
No reason... So, what's coming up？
Who knows？ I gave you a hint just now, so think hard.
Is there anything you want right now？
I'd like my allowance raised a little？
...Then talk to your mom about that？
Not that kind of thing. CDs, books... THINGS.
Let's see... Oh！ I'm suddenly craving potato chips！
Buy them and eat them yourself！
You're so hard to shop for... So plain, or no particular tastes, or...
If I had to say... a kiss from ▲小早川＊▲？
Sigh... I don't even have the energy to kick you right now...
Continuing from last time, did you think about what you want？
A girl in my class asked me what would be good to give a guy as a present...
You know. Since Rinko does have a boyfriend.
Let's see... With presents, isn't it the thought that counts, more than the thing？
What's that, so corny. ...Well, if that's fine with you, it's fine with Rinko...
Isn't your birthday coming up soon？
Won't you spend it with me, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hehe, kidding. You can look forward to it, I guess？
Hahaha, I know！ It's coming up soon.
Not really. I just don't think much of it being my birthday.
Huh. Then I'll honestly look forward to it.
Hey？ Do you remember your birthdays from when you were little？
Rinko... only remembers the bad ones.
Like Dad not being home on my birthday because of work...
Birthdays make you more sentimental than usual.
So I figured if I just spent it like a normal day, I wouldn't make sad memories...
...From now on, let's make happy memories, then.
Look at you, acting all cool！
We talked about it the other day. I won't forget！
Getting my hopes up too much is kind of scary, though...
Then I'll hope just a tiny bit.
So I can rest easy, like I'm aboard a sinking ship？
The birthday first. Though the present too, kind of...
Oh, no, never mind. I have to save the fun for the moment itself.
Besides, what I'm really looking forward to isn't the present. It's having someone to spend it with.
I wish my birthday would hurry up.
You know what day is coming up, right？
Don't tell me something impossible like you forgot？
It seems to have slipped my mind...
Well, Rinko seems to have forgotten who YOU are！
Sigh... To think I've been going out with a guy like this for a whole year...
Oh... The day ▲小早川＊▲ and I started going out...
A year of going out, and somehow we've gotten along, huh？
Lovey-dovey... Aren't you embarrassed saying that？
You've been my girlfriend a year. Aren't you used to it by now？
I'm not used to it... Is it weird that I still get butterflies with you？
I don't think it's weird. I get them too.
My heart's always pounding, wondering when you'll blow up...
Kidding. My heart pounds whenever I'm with ▲小早川＊▲. Walking home, on dates...
We've been going out a year now...
Well, fine. Then let's answer at the same time？ Okay？
It's almost a year since we started going out, huh？
Looking back, a year goes by fast...
Are you thinking, "I can't believe I lasted a year with this one"？
What？ It's only been a year. We're just getting started.
I see... Yeah, I guess so.
Thanks to Rinko's patience, I'd say.
If I weren't holding back, I might say "I want to live with you." Would that be okay？
That kind of future wouldn't be bad...
I think about this sometimes, you know？
...Was Rinko really the right one for you？
What a weird thing to ask...
Because Rinko's selfish, and she always makes you worry...
That's not true. All of that is part of what makes ▲小早川＊▲.
You don't mind having Rinko as your girlfriend？
...It has to be ▲小早川＊▲. Nobody else.
Why do you think people fall for each other？
I wonder. I've never thought about it.
They meet by some incredible chance, and before they know it, they love each other...
The odds of a relationship like this happening are astronomical, right？
I don't believe in fate or destiny... but I want to give myself credit for falling for you.
Out of astronomical odds, I drew you...
In a book I read a long time ago...
It said people fall for each other because humans are programmed that way.
Programmed？ You mean in our genes？
Yeah. But Rinko feels like that's not all.
But I want to figure it out from here on...
I think if I'm with you, I'll figure it out...
Well, you'll find out soon, so look forward to it.
Hey？ Is there anything you want right now？
Um... You know！ I was thinking of getting my dad a present.
Your dad... A tie, to play it safe？
A tie... Well, that might help.
Then is there anything YOU want right now？
Nothing comes to mind right now... I'll think about it.
Oh... about the present thing I asked about...
But I don't think there's anything I really want right now...
Really...？ Nothing you really want, huh...
Right now my life with ▲小早川＊▲ is all I need, or something！
Hmm... That makes me happy, but it doesn't help...
Hey, isn't your birthday coming up？
You remembered. Oh yeah, it is.
Hey, hey, has a girl ever celebrated your birthday before？
Huh...!? I see... So a girl has celebrated it before...
At a grade school class party, though...
Geez. But then, Rinko's the first girl you'll spend your birthday with？
I see, hehe. Can't wait for your birthday.
Oh！ It's almost ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday, right？
No way. It's my girlfriend's birthday.
Hehe, thanks. Then can I start looking forward to it？
I keep staring at the calendar every day.
Yeah. For Rinko, birthdays have been lonely days since she was little.
Having someone celebrate it with me was my dream...
No, it's okay now, see？ I have my boyfriend.
Yeah. Next year, and the year after, let's celebrate together.
Thanks. For making Rinko's dream come true...
Save that for your actual birthday, okay？
A birthday means one step closer to being a grown-up, huh.
Yeah. I wonder how much more grown-up a year makes you.
You're not a grown-up, but sometimes... you suddenly seem grown-up...
But you mean I'm usually childish, right？
...But whatever your age, ▲小早川＊▲ will always be cute to me.
I haven't forgotten. Your birthday, right？
I didn't think you'd forget, but I figured I'd check, just in case.
I wanted it to be a surprise, but if there's something you want, that'd be better, right？
For Rinko... a birthday with the person she loves. That's the best present.
So... stay by my side, okay？
Huh...？ I think it's kind of coming back to me.
Soon it'll be... since you started going out with Rinko...
Oh！ It's already been a year？
This year went by in a flash. How was it？
Hehe... Same for Rinko, you know？
Before I knew it, ▲小早川＊▲ became a natural part of my life.
Oh, I get that. Like water, or air...
We've both become that for each other, huh.
If Rinko suddenly disappeared, what would happen to you？
I couldn't breathe. I'd be gasping in agony...
A year feels long, but it's short, huh.
Yeah. You changed this year too, didn't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I changed？ I love you way, way more than before.
Me too... wait, no, no. I mean, like... you got kinder.
When we first met, you were all, "Yeah, I'm contrary. Got a problem？"
Maybe I've gotten a little more honest about how I feel？
I'm still a little contrary, though. Just a little.
Hey, thanks for being with me this whole year...
Since going out with you, Rinko's grown a little, I think...
I can accept things that are different from what I think...
And I think I've gotten a little more honest...
It'd be nice if we both keep growing from here on.
Yeah. Rinko's going to be an even better girlfriend... so stay by her side forever.
Me too. Next year, the year after, forever, I want to be by ▲小早川＊▲'s side.
Keep being Rinko's wonderful boyfriend from now on too...
Yeah. Here's to us, from now on.
